blocks.task_summary: Show that the area of the 'C' shaped region between two concentric sectors with reflex angle 5.2 rad, outer radius 10 cm, and inner radius r cm is 260 − 2.6r².
method_path: Apply sector area formula ½R²θ to outer circle: ½ × 10² × 5.2 = 260
Apply sector area formula ½r²θ to inner circle: ½ × r² × 5.2 = 2.6r²
accepted_alternatives: Use full circle area minus non-reflex sector: ½×10²×π − ½×10²×(2π−5.2) − [½×r²×π − ½×r²×(2π−5.2)], simplifying to 260 − 2.6r²

evidence.basis: M1: use of sector area formula to find area of at least one sector. A1: working leading directly to AG. Expression shown: ½×5.2×100 − ½×5.2×r².

blocks.task_summary: Given the area is 64 cm², find r and then compute the perimeter of the 'C'.
method_path: Add two radial end segments: 2(10 − r)

evidence.basis: (i) (A1) for 260−2.6r²=64, A1 for r=8.68... (cm). (ii) (A1) for 10×5.2 OR 8.68...×5.2, (M1) for substituting r into 5.2×r + 5.2×10 + 2(10−r), A1 for perimeter=99.8 (cm).
